title: The long corridor
goals: Reach the door at the end of the corridor.
Do it in fewer than 2 lines.
starting_code:
# Walk to the door at the end of the corridor.
wizard.move_right()
hints: How many tiles away is the door? Count them.
`move_right` can take a number: `wizard.move_right(2)` takes two steps.
intro: A long corridor! Six lines would walk it. One line with a number walks it too.
